about_the_game:
Growing Wild is a cozy third-person tower defense game where you play as a living scarecrow on a quest to restore a corrupted world. Defend magical lands solo or with a friend, combining classic tower defense action with exploration, farming, decorating, and a heartfelt story. This charming adventure blends strategic gameplay with relaxing, creative activities in a vibrant, welcoming world.

Level by level, it is your task to free the world from corruption. Each level begins at a Magical Center still untouched by decay. Expand outward by placing magical plants and liberating Mystic Nodes to restore and stabilize large areas of nature. Everything tainted by corruption remains hidden until reclaimed, revealing ancient ruins, new spells, unique plants, and decorative items.

Prepare yourself against nightly waves of shadowy creatures, seeking to overrun the central source of magic and complete the process of corruption. Savor the calm before the storm and take your time during the daylight hours to place magical plants for your defense. Each plant offers its own special attacks and abilities, allowing for strategic placement as you prepare for nightfall. Support your plants with powerful spells to turn the tide in battle. Only by fully restoring each area can you truly stop the corruption and let nature flourish again.

Experience the adventure solo or team up with a friend in co-op mode. Combine your strengths and work together to defend against the corruption and explore the game's mystical story. Coordinate your strategies, share resources, and discover hidden secrets as you restore the world side by side.

Take a break between battles with soothing activities like farming, decorating your hub, or simply exploring. Upgrade your plants and personalize your home, all within a calming atmosphere. With an easy-to-learn gameplay loop and a gentle difficulty curve, the game invites you to unwind and enjoy the adventure at your own pace.
